newsitem.title: USA: Delta Air Lines expands Atlanta service.
newsitem.headline: Delta Air Lines expands Atlanta service.

text.p: Delta Air Lines said on Thursday that it will expand services from its Atlanta hub to six cities in the fall.
Included among the new services will be two new flights daily to Melbourne, and one new flight to Daytona Beach, Florida, Delta said in a statement.
In addition, the airline said it would introduce nonstop service to Orange County, California, from Cincinnati, and new nonstop service between Cincinnati and Salt Lake City, Utah.
With the new fall schedule, which begins September 8, Delta said its Atlanta operation grows to 617 flights a day.
